rektion: etw. (Akk.) umfahren (einen Stau, eine Baustelle, ein Hindernis umfahren)
definition_de: um etwas herumfahren, um es zu vermeiden (einen Stau, eine Baustelle, die Innenstadt umfahren). Trennbar (úmfahren, hat umgefahren) heißt es 'etwas mit dem Auto umstoßen'.
example_de: Weil die Autobahn völlig verstopft war, umfuhren wir den Stau über kleine Landstraßen.
example_en: Because the motorway was completely jammed, we bypassed the traffic jam on small country roads.
visual_idea: Collocation 'einen Stau umfahren': a drone view of a long, stopped column of cars on the Autobahn, and one red car taking a narrow country road that curves in an arc through the fields around the jam. The arc makes the 'around' visible in one still frame. A traffic jam is the everyday case (navigation apps say 'Stau umfahren'), and an aerial view of a road is easy to draw.
image_prompt: high aerial drone view of a German Autobahn in summer, one direction completely jammed with a long dense column of stopped cars and trucks stretching to the horizon, beside it a narrow country road leaves the motorway and curves in a wide arc through green and yellow fields and past a small village around the jam, a single bright red car drives alone on this curving country road, clear sky, sharp detail
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels
video_prompt: high aerial drone view: a long column of cars stands still on an Autobahn while a single red car leaves at an exit and drives smoothly along a narrow country road that curves around the jam through the fields; slow forward drone movement
